messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick FYI  we updated the caregiver leave wording in the handbook this morning to clarify intermittent leave eligibility and how parental/adoptive leave coordinates with short-term disability. Please review and ack if you sign off on manager-level approvals. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Maya (People Ops): We're also rolling a short (10-12min) microlearning module covering the change + data handling for leave requests. Completion required for all managers and manager-facing ICs by Apr 12. Tracker + LMS link in thread below.

Maya (People Ops): Tracker steps: 1) confirm team names in column B, 2) add a manager ack in column D, 3) paste LMS export CSV into the "LMS Import" tab for reconciliation. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xxx-TrackerLink

Maya (People Ops): LMS admin bulk export example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $LMS_API_TOKEN" \\
  "https://lms.internal/api/v1/completions?course_id=caregiver_2026&since=2026-03-01" \\
  -o completions.csv
```
Please drop the CSV on the import tab.

Omar (People Ops): I left a suggested alternate sentence in the handbook comments around "eligible caregiver". Legal review pending; once Lina signs off we'll snapshot the handbook and send the policy email tomorrow.

Lina (Legal): Reviewed. Two minor tweaks: added examples for eligibility and recommended clarifying retroactive lookback windows. Resolve my comment about "30-day administrative window" and I can sign-off. Also note EU retention requirements.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Question  do contractors need to take the microlearning? Our vendor staff may have separate agreements.

Jules (HR Support): Mandatory for W2 employees and full-time contractors who make people decisions. If a vendor contract requires otherwise, escalate to people-ops@redwood. We'll add a contractor flag column on the tracker.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Thanks  I'll mark my contractors in the sheet after I confirm with the vendor leads.

Maya (People Ops): We can run two optional 30-min drop-in Q&A sessions next week: Tue 11am PT and Thu 4pm PT. Please RSVP in column G on the tracker.

Sam R (Eng Manager): I'll RSVP for Tue.

Lina (Legal): For EU-headcount, keep proof of ack/consent in retention for 3 years per local regs. Add an "EU" column in the tracker.

Maya (People Ops): Done  added EU column.

HR-bot: Reminder scheduled  automated manager reminders for unconfirmed teams will send Apr 5.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Quick ask  can initial manager acks be an emoji on the tracker or do you need typed names? I only have 2 minutes per team. :sweat_smile:

Maya (People Ops): Emoji is fine for initial ack. For audit we need a timestamped confirmation row; people-ops will populate timestamps when reconciling completions.

Omar (People Ops): Action items: - Managers: confirm teams in Col B by Mar 30 - Managers/manager-facing ICs: complete module by Apr 12 - Managers: RSVP for drop-ins (Col G) - People Ops: export LMS completions on Apr 13 and reconcile.

Jules (HR Support): I'll draft a short 1:1 nudge template to paste into manager cadence so we don't spam channels.

Sam R (Eng Manager): Template would be perfect. Also can you add a per-team completion % column so I can track in 1:1s?

Maya (People Ops): Yes  added a "Completion %" calculated column on the tracker. It updates after the LMS import.

Lina (Legal): One more reminder: do not post medical details in Slack. Use the secure intake form linked on the handbook page for any medical documentation.

Maya (People Ops): Agreed  added a bold notice on the handbook page. Thanks everyone. :heart:
